prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW original 2D sprite sheet with exactly nine isolated full-body poses arranged 3x3 on real transparent background. Reference is the approved adult man neutral karate avatar: match identical anatomy, bald blank featureless face, skin, crisp ink outlines and painted white karate gi.  Do NOT redraw reference poses; draw a friendly pre-match fist-touch greeting facing screen RIGHT in three-quarter view. Exactly same skull diameter and body proportions across ALL nine drawings. Bare feet on consistent ground line within each cell; each figure fully visible and separate, wide transparent gutters. Uniform overhead dojo lighting. Belt knot/waistband/both ends vivid magenta, elsewhere no magenta. No background/ground shadow/text/grid/labels/3D/motion blur/effects.
This is a respectful relaxed fist-bump between karate players before fighting, NOT an attack: lead fist loosely closed, no punching lunge, elbow always bent, shoulders relaxed, other arm hanging at side, trunk upright. The contact fist must be the rightmost visible skin of the whole figure, pointing right, so another mirrored fighter can touch its knuckles. Legs nearly straight in small natural standing stance, NO wide fighting/kiba stance during greeting.
Reading order:
1. Upright relaxed attention facing right, both arms down, feet close.
2. Small walking step right to approach opponent, arms naturally down.
3. Plant feet close/shoulder width, weight centered, lead elbow starts to bend and hand lifts.
4. Begin extending lead forearm in friendly greeting, loose fist low in front, elbow bent.
5. Fully offered loose lead fist for gentle touch at HIGH height: near upper chest, fist clearly to right of torso, softly bent elbow. Other hand at side.
6. Fully offered loose lead fist for gentle touch at MIDDLE height: at lower chest/solar plexus, fist clearly to right of torso, softly bent elbow. Other hand at side.
7. Fully offered loose lead fist for gentle touch at LOW height: just above belt/upper abdomen, fist clearly to right of torso, softly bent elbow. Other hand at side.
8. Retract greeting hand toward own body, elbow bent, relax shoulder.
9. Return relaxed upright attention with both arms down, feet close, match first pose.
Poses 5/6/7 differ ONLY the forearm/hand elevation, enabling touch between children/teens/adults without changing stature. Two correct hands and feet per pose, normal fingers/knuckles. Highest drawing quality matching approved reference exactly.
